phrase_hy: Զգեստդ գեղեցիկ է, որտեղի՞ց ես գնել։
phrase_en: Your dress is beautiful, where did you buy it?
I will call in the evening, we will talk.
Do you know where my glove is?

note: formal alternative to goodbye; Հաջող is the short form
lit. we will meet: հանդիպել — to meet, կ- — will

hy: Ի՞նչ է քո անունը / Անունդ ի՞նչ է
